name: Wack Track Pack
summary: Grillin's Wack Track Pack (abbreviated GWTP or WTP) is a custom track distribution created by GioMacGrillin. It was made with the intention of being a fun alternative to existing Pulsar distributions, with the aim of minimizing what is believed to be the more rage-inducing aspects of the game, rebalancing vehicles, item odds, character stats, and prioritizing fun.
